Subject: Manager performance coaching workshop — signups open

Hi all,

Following up from the leadership sync: Talent and L&D have contracted Coach+ Workshops to run a mandatory manager training series focused on performance management, calibration conversations, and coaching for difficult conversations. We want every manager who will be running reviews this cycle to attend one live session.

Logistics (high level):
- What: 2.5 hour interactive workshop (performance feedback + difficult conversations clinic)
- When: recurring sessions starting Mar 10 — multiple regional times (US/EMEA/APAC)
- Who: managers of ICs and people managers (first-time managers should attend the "new manager" slot)
- Format: breakout roleplays, real-case scenario work, and a post-session 90-min clinic for live coaching

Action items for you:
1) Please RSVP on the signup sheet (link below) with your preferred session by EOD next Wed (Mar 3).
2) If you have sensitive cases you'd like handled anonymously in the roleplays, send short redacted notes to me (Evelyn) — we will share with Coach+ under an NDA.

Attachments: manager_coaching_overview.pdf (agenda + facilitator bios), signup_sheet.gsheets (please pick a slot).

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xSignupSheet

We want the sessions to be practical and relevant to the review cycle; please flag any hard constraints (e.g., headcount calibration weeks) and I'll coordinate timing.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Head of Talent & L&D | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Evelyn — this looks valuable. A couple quick questions before I confirm sessions for my team: 

1) Can Coach+ split a session that is explicitly for new managers (we have three new managers who would benefit from more structure) versus experienced managers? I don't want new managers to be overwhelmed by scenarios that assume prior calibration experience.

2) Confidentiality: for sensitive examples (ongoing PIPs or personnel issues) will Coach+ sign a one-off NDA to allow us to share redacted notes? You mentioned NDA but wanted to confirm the logistics. Also, will anything from roleplays be shared back to people leaders outside of the anonymized summary?

3) Do you have a sample deck or a 1-pager I can forward to my leads that explains the clinic format (90-min follow-ups)?

If it's helpful I can sketch two proposed times for our team (US mornings preferred). I will hold off on RSVPing until I have clarity—thanks.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa & Evelyn,

Thanks for the questions — quick answers below and a short proposal attached.

1) New manager vs experienced split: absolutely. We recommend a dedicated 90-minute "Foundations for New Managers" followed by a 2.5-hour session for experienced managers. We can also run the Foundations repeat across multiple dates.

2) Confidentiality & NDA: we will sign Redwood's standard one-off NDA for the purpose of reviewing anonymized case materials. Anything captured during breakouts (notes, debriefs) will be delivered as an anonymized summary to Talent only; we will not share recordings or raw notes with any other parties unless expressly permitted.

3) Sample materials: attached manager_coaching_overview.pdf and scenario_examples.docx. The 90-min clinic is intended for live coaching — participants can bring one active case and we will model a feedback script + facilitator coaching.

Proposed customizations for Redwood:
- Sales/Customer-facing strand: incorporate performance metrics tied to quota & pipeline stress (roleplays sourced from your ops examples).
- Calibration module: 30-min walkthrough on rating scale alignment and evidence capture.

We can run a short prep call with you and one of your Sr. managers to collect anonymized scenarios. Suggested prep slots: Wed Mar 4 or Thu Mar 5 (US mornings).

Attachments: manager_coaching_overview.pdf, scenario_examples.docx

Best,
Lydia Park | Senior Facilitator | Coach+ Workshops
